subject: Bugbear Warrior
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait. Outline art only. A tall bugbear warrior drops through a broken crack in a dungeon-hall ceiling to ambush below. He is a large hairy goblinoid soldier, taller and bulkier than a hobgoblin, not a troll. Blunt snout, short pointed ears, shaggy fur in large clumps, simple hide armor plates, one big spiked club. The ceiling hole is broken stone and hanging rock you can color, with white open shapes inside the crack. No solid black void. No black puddle on the floor. No decorative frame around the page. The hall has block walls, a fully closed wooden door, large flagstones, one crate, one barrel. Every area is a closed white shape to color. The drawing fills the sheet.
